title: Meter error
description: One node of a cell and arm across its seeds: its upload meter's reading over the uplink it had (1 exact, under 1 low) each second as a spectrogram, the colour the share of the seeds whose reading fell in each band 0.05 wide (every reading of 2 or more in the top one), and the node's uplink across the seeds (p10–p90 band, p50 line, Mbit/s). Pick the node in its list, where the seed (the publisher) is marked. From the meter_samples table: runs from before it, or a node outside WAN mode without a rate limit, have none.
